answers.reason: As head of a faculty representing it towards the central leadership, the dean holds an office that participates in the central senate.
The budget planning round allocates funds to faculties, and the dean represents the faculty towards the university leadership.
The dean leads the faculty and holds a higher office than faculty committees, permitting participation in bodies below their level.
The description explicitly states that the dean chairs the faculty council.
The study commission advises the faculty council, and as a higher office holder, the dean may take part in all bodies below their level.
The examination board is a faculty-level body below the dean's office, so the dean is permitted to take part.
This round awards the faculty's internal grants, placing it under the faculty leadership where the dean may participate by rank.
As a working group within the faculty's degree programmes, it lies below the dean's office, entitling the dean to take part.
Choosing teaching laboratory equipment within the faculty is a subordinate decision occasion in which the dean may participate by virtue of higher office.
Planning the orientation week for the faculty's new students is a subordinate task below the dean's level, permitting the dean to take part.
